full_judgment: 13. It appears that the learned trial Court have discussed the facts of the case more elaborately with reference to the evidence and the legal presumption and came to the finding that both the brothers took settlement and both of them paid salami money of Taka six hundred to the landlord by selling that paternal land to Halima Khatun. The trial Court further found from the evidence of PWs and DWs that both brothers, Tufan Das and Kala Chand Das have been living in the suit property in their respective separate huts since 37/38 years with their family and that the decree obtained by Tufan Das in Title Suit No. 555 of 1958 was an ex parte and collusive decree and this had been done by elder brother Tufan Das to deprive the younger brother Kala Chand Das from the suit property. The learned Subordinate Judge also came to the conclusion that the learned trial Court has rightly come to this decision.
